quizName: DMV Practice Test #3 25 Questions • Passing Score 19

questions.question: When should you wear reflective clothing?
questions.explanation: Wear reflective materials at night to help other drivers see you. Bright colors with reflective materials make you more visible on the road.

questions.question: Why should you ride in the left part of your lane when preparing to pass?

options.text: It helps you see better ahead.
It makes it harder to see ahead.
It makes it hard to see past the other vehicle.
It allows the other driver to go faster.

questions.correctAnswerText: It helps you see better ahead.
questions.explanation: Ride in the left part of your lane to see better and to make yourself more visible to drivers in the passing lane.

questions.question: For the best protection, a helmet should:
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) standards. It should fit snugly all the way around with no obvious damage.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, what should you wear?

options.text: No jacket if it is warm.
Always wear a jacket, even in warm weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always wear a jacket, even in warm weather.
questions.explanation: Always wear a long-sleeved jacket when riding, even in warm weather. It protects you and helps prevent dehydration. Also wear long pants and tuck in your shoelaces to keep them from catching on the motorcycle.

questions.question: How does riding with a passenger affect a motorcycle?

options.text: It does not change how the motorcycle handles.
It is usually safe for new riders.
It changes how the motorcycle handles.
It helps new riders get used to different situations.

questions.correctAnswerText: It changes how the motorcycle handles.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds extra weight, which changes how the motorcycle handles. Only experienced riders should carry passengers.

questions.question: How important are signals on a motorcycle?

options.text: More important than signals on cars and trucks.
Only use them if another vehicle is right next to you.
Less important than signals on cars and trucks.

questions.correctAnswerText: More important than signals on cars and trucks.
questions.explanation: Motorcyclists are more at risk than car or truck drivers, so using signals is even more important for motorcycles.

questions.question: What should you do before riding with a passenger?

options.text: Assume they have ridden a motorcycle before.
Do not assume they have ridden before and explain what to do.
Do not explain anything since they are not in control.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not assume they have ridden before and explain what to do.
questions.explanation: Never assume your passenger knows what to do. Give them complete instructions before every ride to keep both of you safe.

questions.question: What does a face shield do?

options.text: Does not protect as well as goggles.

questions.explanation: A plastic, impact-resistant face shield gives the best protection for your eyes and face. Glasses or sunglasses are not enough. In Vermont, you do not need eye protection if your motorcycle has a windshield, but it is still recommended.

questions.question: What type of sign is rectangular?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs like speed limits are usually rectangular with white background and black letters. You must follow the rules shown on these signs.

questions.question: On which surface does a motorcycle have the best traction?
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have poor traction on wet pavement, gravel, mud, snow, ice, painted lines, and metal plates. Dry pavement is the safest surface for traction.

questions.question: What should motorcycle pants be made of to protect a rider?

options.text: Material that flaps in the wind
Short material that exposes the legs

questions.explanation: Wear pants made of leather or sturdy synthetic material to cover your entire legs. The pants should fit snugly but not restrict your movement.

questions.question: Which of the following should you NOT check on your tires?
questions.explanation: Before riding, check your tire air pressure, tread, and general wear. You do not need to check tire flexibility.

questions.question: How much alcohol can the body eliminate per hour?
questions.explanation: Your body can eliminate about one drink per hour on average.

questions.question: When braking on a motorcycle, which brakes should you use?

options.text: Both brakes at the same time
Either brake, but never both together

questions.correctAnswerText: Both brakes at the same time
questions.explanation: Use both brakes together for the best stopping power.

questions.question: What material provides the best protection for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather provides the best protection for riders. Always wear clothing that covers your legs and arms completely.

questions.question: What type of soles should motorcycle riding boots have?
questions.explanation: Choose boots or shoes that are high and sturdy with soles made of hard, durable, slip-resistant material to support your ankles.

questions.question: Which of the following do you NOT need to check before riding?

options.text: That both brake controls activate the brake light
That the paint is not scratched

questions.correctAnswerText: That the paint is not scratched
questions.explanation: Before riding, check your tires, oil level, all lights (headlight, taillight, signals, and brake light), and brake controls. You do not need to check for paint scratches.

questions.question: When should you use your mirrors?
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often. Use them before changing lanes, when stopping at intersections, and before slowing down.

questions.question: You have been drinking. You wait one hour per drink before riding. What is true?

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drinking and riding
Your riding skills will not be affected
Side effects from drinking may still remain
You will be fine if you ride slowly

questions.correctAnswerText: Side effects from drinking may still remain
questions.explanation: Even if you wait one hour per drink, alcohol can still build up in your body and affect your abilities and judgment.

questions.question: How can a motorcycle operator slow down?
questions.explanation: Downshifting slows down a motorcycle. Note that downshifting does not activate the brake lights.

questions.question: What does smoothly downshifting do on a motorcycle?

options.text: It lets the engine help slow the motorcycle.
It should not be done around other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: It lets the engine help slow the motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Downshifting smoothly can help slow your motorcycle using the engine. If you use engine braking, use your brake lights so other drivers know you are slowing down.

questions.question: What type of sign is yellow with black words or symbols?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black words or symbols. They alert drivers to dangerous road conditions ahead.

questions.question: When should you do a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Check your motorcycle before every ride. Small problems can be more serious on a motorcycle than on a car, so regular checks prevent dangerous situations.

questions.question: What is important for motorcycle safety?

options.text: Assume all parts of your motorcycle work fine.
Do a full check before every ride.
Do a full check once a month.
Do a full check twice a week.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do a full check before every ride.
questions.explanation: Small mechanical problems are more dangerous on a motorcycle than on a car. Always do a thorough check of your motorcycle before you ride.

questions.question: What can happen from long-term exposure to wind noise while riding?

options.text: It is safer than listening to music.

questions.explanation: Wind noise while riding can harm your hearing over time, even when wearing a helmet. Wear proper hearing protection to prevent damage.
